panels.title: Seconds since last accepted delivery (not source value age)
panels.description: Rises when acquisition, OPC UA, MQTT or ingestion stops. Consult collector JSONL to distinguish causes. An old SourceTimestamp can be valid for an unchanged reading.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now()-max(ts)) AS seconds FROM telemetry WHERE asset='furnace-01' AND signal='billet_temp_c'
